import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def main():
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

    y = train_df["Cover_Type"]
    X = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"])
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])

    # Standardize column names to ensure clean parsing
    cols = [c.replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "") for c in X.columns]
    X.columns = cols
    X_test.columns = cols

    # Identify categorical-like binary features
    cat_cols = [c for c in X.columns if "Wilderness" in c or "Soil" in c]

    # Strict hold-out validation split
    X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
    )

    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 7,
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 127,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "min_child_samples": 31,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1,
        "random_state": 42,
        "verbose": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "force_col_wise": True,
    }

    print("Training model on 90% hold-out split for validation...")
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params, n_estimators=1500)
    model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        categorical_feature=cat_cols,
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, silent=True)],
    )

    # Compute validation accuracy strictly on hold-out set (no refitting allowed here)
    y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.4f}")

    # Retrain on full training data for final test set submission
    print("Retraining on full training data for final submission...")
    best_iters = int(model.best_iteration_) if model.best_iteration_ > 0 else 1500
    full_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params, n_estimators=best_iters)
    full_model.fit(X, y, categorical_feature=cat_cols)

    print("Predicting on test set...")
    y_pred_test = full_model.predict(X_test)

    submission = sample_sub.copy()
    submission["Cover_Type"] = y_pred_test
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
